# v0.1.0 — First public release

Rusty Cleaner is an open-source, Rust-native file cleaner with a desktop
interface for Linux, macOS and Windows.

## Read-only by design

Scanning never deletes anything. Every cleanup is confirmed in a dialog and
**goes to the system trash/recycle bin**, from which it can be restored
in-app. Everything the app does is recorded in an append-only activity log
(JSON Lines) that you can open from the settings page.

## What it finds

- **Trash** — items in the system trash, with size, restore and empty
- **Temporary files** — stale files in the OS temp directories
- **Browser caches** — known cache locations for Chrome, Chromium, Firefox
  and friends on every platform
- **Messenger media** — media and downloads from Telegram, Discord,
  WhatsApp, Signal, Slack and Element, with age/size filters
- **Old app data** — leftover data from uninstalled applications, detected
  by cross-referencing the installed package database
- **Large & old files** — anything over 100 MB untouched for six months
- **Duplicates** — byte-identical files, confirmed with full content
  comparison; runtime binaries (WebView2, Electron libs) are never offered
  as duplicates

## Desktop app

- Dashboard with per-category cards, live scan progress with stop button,
  elapsed time and the folder currently being scanned
- Results table with search, sorting, category filter and bulk selection
- Trash restore flow
- Settings page: interface language (English/Português), activity log folder
  and user-excluded folders (with a native folder picker)
- Automatic updates through signed Tauri updater artifacts

## Packaging

Installers for Linux (`.deb`, `.rpm`, AppImage), macOS (`.dmg`) and Windows
(`.exe` setup, `.msi`), plus an `rusty-cleaner-bin` AUR package.

> **Windows note**: the installer is not signed with a commercial
> certificate yet, so SmartScreen may show a warning ("More info" →
> "Run anyway"). SignPath integration is ready for when a certificate is
> available.
